specs.Item Type Name: ANT Master 22 Wireless Keyboard and Mouse Combo

features: Note: The universal USB dongle is stored inside the keyboard’s battery compartment. Remove the battery cover and take out the USB receiver before first use to enable instant pairing.

FULL-SIZE 104-KEY PRODUCTIVITY WITH NUMPAD: Enjoy a familiar full-size keyboard layout designed for everyday typing, documents, spreadsheets and data entry. The dedicated number pad makes ANT Master 22 a practical choice for home, office and study setups.

2.4GHz WIRELESS FREEDOM UP TO 10m: Create a cleaner and more flexible workspace with reliable 2.4GHz wireless connectivity and an operating range of up to 10 metres. The USB receiver helps reduce cable clutter around your desktop or compatible laptop.

3 ADJUSTABLE DPI LEVELS UP TO 1600: Choose between 800, 1200 and 1600 DPI to match your preferred cursor speed. Switch between controlled navigation and faster cursor movement based on your screen size and everyday computing needs.

BUILT FOR EVERYDAY COMPUTING: The keyboard is rated for up to 5 million keystrokes and the mouse for up to 5 million clicks, providing dependable performance for regular office work, learning, browsing and home computing.

WORK ACROSS YOUR COMPATIBLE DEVICES: Designed for use with Windows, Mac, Linux and Android-compatible devices, helping you use one practical keyboard and mouse combo across different work and everyday computing environments.
